coordinate_definition.origin_xy: vertical projection of the CS-400 black vertex-hole axis
coordinate_definition.x_positive: from the vertex outward along the long arm
coordinate_definition.y_positive: from the vertex outward along the short arm

multi_frame_visual_detection.method: visual classification plus constrained Hough-circle median over all RGB frames

model_geometry_provenance: Nominalized marker centers from the same physical CS-400 ruler reconstructed with the 2026-08-29 raw 16-bit depth calibration; rounded to 370/110 mm on X and 65/210 mm on Y.

approximate_depth_decode.fit_source: known tabletop plane projected into the depth camera and green-table pixels in RGB
approximate_depth_decode.warning: Depth.mp4 is a lossy 8-bit colorized preview. Recovered depth is suitable only for visualization and has about 20 mm quantization.
